description: This Java class, MainMethodExceptionHandler, wraps the execution of a main method (represented by a Callable<ActorSystem>) to catch and log all Throwables, including Errors and RuntimeExceptions. It provides a static factory method for instantiation with a specified Logger, and executes the main method body while handling exceptions to ensure proper logging and re-throwing.

classes.name: MainMethodExceptionHandler
classes.description: A utility class that executes a Runnable (represented as a Callable<ActorSystem>) within a try-catch block to log and re-throw all Throwables, including Errors and Exceptions, for a main method.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method that creates and returns an instance of MainMethodExceptionHandler with the provided Logger, checking for null.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the mainMethodBody Callable<ActorSystem> within a try-catch block to handle all Throwables, re-throwing them after logging.

methods.name: tryToRunMainMethodBody
methods.description: Private method called by 'call' that executes the mainMethodBody and catches RuntimeException, Error, and Throwable to log and re-throw or wrap in RuntimeException.
